oliver: Great. Action items: Samir = ops checklist + vouchers (Wed EOD), Priya = cert rubric (Tue), Oliver = one-pager design (Thu). Maya will notify Partner Ops for emergency contact details.

partners-bot: Reaction logged: :white_check_mark: preflight event scheduled.
